method: Heat the oil in a pan over low-medium heat. Add the sugar and let it melt slowly until amber brown, about 2-3 minutes, stirring gently so it doesn't burn.
Add the garlic and shallot and cook for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.
Gently place the sardines into the pan.
Pour in the fish sauce, water, black pepper and chilli flakes. Bring to the boil; it will bubble and thicken into a glossy caramel sauce.
Spoon the sauce over the sardines and simmer on low for 8-10 minutes, letting the sauce reduce and coat the fish.
Turn off the heat, top with the green onions and let it sit for 2 minutes so the glaze thickens. Serve with jasmine rice.
